summary: Comprehensive testing of new features completed: PO Pabrik, Pengeluaran, Laba & Keuangan, HPP snapshot logic, and Dashboard financial cards. All backend APIs and frontend UI elements are working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: All 27 tests passed - Products have harga_pabrik field, HPP snapshot logic works correctly (historic transactions freeze HPP), PO Pabrik CRUD operations, Pengeluaran CRUD operations, Laba calculations, Dashboard financial data
Frontend: Dashboard displays 'Keuangan Bulan Ini' section with 5 financial cards (Omset, HPP, Pengeluaran, Laba Bersih, Hutang ke Pabrik)
Frontend: Produk page shows 'Harga Pabrik' column in variant tables, displays 'belum diisi' in red for variants without harga_pabrik
Frontend: Transaksi page shows HPP and Laba Kotor columns in table, header displays Total Omset and Laba Kotor
Frontend: PO Pabrik page fully functional - form, stat cards (Total Pembelian, Hutang ke Pabrik, Jumlah PO), table, filters, export buttons
Frontend: Pengeluaran page fully functional - form with correct categories (BBM / Transport / Armada, Lain-lain), stat cards, table, filters

Frontend: Laba page shows all 6 stat cards (Omset, HPP, Laba Kotor, Pengeluaran, Laba Bersih, Margin Bersih), Rincian Perhitungan breakdown, Laba per Produk table, Pengeluaran per Kategori, Pembelian ke Pabrik card
Frontend: Negative number formatting is CORRECT - displays as '-Rp 210.000' (minus BEFORE Rp, not after)
Frontend: All 9 navigation menu items present and working (Dashboard, Transaksi, PO Pabrik, Pengeluaran, Laba & Keuangan, Rekap Bulanan, Produk, Customer, Profil)

Backend: HPP SNAPSHOT RULE VERIFIED - When a transaction is created, it captures harga_pabrik at that moment. When the product's harga_pabrik is changed later, the historic transaction's HPP and laba_kotor DO NOT change (frozen), while new transactions use the updated price
Backend: Laba calculation formula verified - Laba Kotor = Omset - HPP, Laba Bersih = Laba Kotor - Pengeluaran
Backend: PO Pabrik does NOT reduce profit directly (only HPP from sold goods reduces profit)
Backend: Export functions working - Excel and PDF exports for Transactions, PO Pabrik, and Laba reports
Frontend: Warning banner on Laba page appears when variants lack harga_pabrik and links to /produk

critical_business_logic_verified: HPP Snapshot: Transactions correctly freeze harga_pabrik at creation time. Historic profit calculations remain accurate even when product prices change later.
Profit Calculation: Laba Kotor = Omset - HPP (only goods SOLD), Laba Bersih = Laba Kotor - Pengeluaran. PO totals do NOT directly reduce profit.
Negative Number Format: Correctly displays as '-Rp 210.000' (minus before Rp) on both Dashboard and Laba pages.
new_features_working: Produk: Harga Pabrik column in variant tables, editable in product dialog (5 inputs: Label, Pabrik, Grosir, SO, Retail)
Transaksi: HPP and Laba Kotor columns, header shows both Total Omset and Laba Kotor
PO Pabrik: Complete CRUD - create/edit/delete PO, status toggle (Belum Bayar/Sudah Bayar), filters (date/pabrik/status), export Excel/PDF, harga_pabrik auto-prefills from product but editable
Pengeluaran: Complete CRUD - create/edit/delete expenses, categories (BBM / Transport / Armada, Lain-lain), validation (amount > 0), filters, stat cards per category

Laba: Month/year selectors, 6 stat cards, Rincian Perhitungan breakdown with correct math, Laba per Produk table, Pengeluaran per Kategori, Pembelian ke Pabrik card (Total PO, Jumlah PO, Hutang), warning banner for missing harga_pabrik, export Excel (4 sheets) and PDF
Dashboard: New 'Keuangan Bulan Ini' section with 5 cards (Omset, HPP, Pengeluaran, Laba Bersih, Hutang ke Pabrik) showing current month data
regression_check: Navigation: All 9 menu items present and functional
Existing features: Dashboard charts, transaction CRUD, customer management, rekap bulanan, profil - all still working
